invariants.rationale: The method would require a non-null context to perform any meaningful work, and a null context would likely result in a ClassCastException when casting to HoodieJavaEngineContext.
instantTime represents the time for the upsert operation and should not be null or empty for correct processing.
A null hoodieRecords would not allow upsert operations, as there would be no records to process.
If hoodieRecords is provided, it should contain records to actually perform the upsert; passing an empty list would not trigger any data mutations.
